text.aria-label: Right glenoid from the side: labrum, capsule and ligaments — 右侧关节盂外侧面观：盂唇、关节囊与韧带
text.tspan: Right glenoid from the side: labrum, capsule and ligaments
右侧关节盂外侧面观：盂唇、关节囊与韧带

text.aria-label: Looking into the right socket from the side, humerus removed. Front of the body on the right, top of the shoulder at the top. — 从外侧看进右侧关节盂（肱骨已移除）。身体前方在右边，肩顶在上方。
text.tspan: Looking into the right socket from the side, humerus removed. Front of the body on the right, top of the shoulder at the top.
从外侧看进右侧关节盂（肱骨已移除）。身体前方在右边，肩顶在上方。

text.aria-label: Glenoid cavity — 关节盂
Acromion — 肩峰
Supraspinatus tendon (cut) — 冈上肌腱（切断）
Long head of biceps tendon — 肱二头肌长头腱
Infraspinatus tendon (cut) — 冈下肌腱（切断）
Glenoid labrum — 盂唇
Inferior glenohumeral ligament, posterior band — 盂肱下韧带后束
Teres minor tendon (cut) — 小圆肌腱（切断）
Axillary pouch (inferior capsule) — 腋囊（关节囊下部）
Coracoacromial ligament — 喙肩韧带
Coracoid process — 喙突
Coracohumeral ligament — 喙肱韧带
Rotator interval — 肩袖间隙
Superior glenohumeral ligament — 盂肱上韧带
Middle glenohumeral ligament — 盂肱中韧带
Joint capsule (cut edge) — 关节囊（切缘）
Subscapularis tendon (cut) — 肩胛下肌腱（切断）
Inferior glenohumeral ligament, anterior band — 盂肱下韧带前束
Body of the scapula (cut) — 肩胛骨体（切断）

text.tspan: Schematic: the capsule and cuff tendons are cut close to the glenoid; sizes and band widths are simplified.
示意图：关节囊和肩袖肌腱在靠近关节盂处切断；大小和韧带宽度经过简化。
